items.title: Edwards Lifesciences Reports Third-Quarter 2026 Results: TMTT Sales Jump 45.6%, TAVR Growth Accelerates, Full-Year Guidance Raised
items.title_zh: 爱德华生命科学公布2026年第三季度业绩:TMTT(经导管二尖瓣/三尖瓣)业务恒定汇率增长45.6%,TAVR增长提速,全年指引上调
items.summary_zh: 爱德华生命科学(Edwards Lifesciences)11月4日公布的2026年第三季度财报显示,总销售额约17.2亿美元,同比增长约10.5%;调整后每股收益0.80美元,同比增长约19%。按业务板块看,TAVR(经导管主动脉瓣)销售额约12.4亿美元,恒定汇率增长8.8%;TMTT(经导管二尖瓣/三尖瓣治疗)销售额2.07亿美元,恒定汇率增长达45.6%,增速远超TAVR。公司同步上调2026全年指引:TAVR恒定汇率增长指引升至9.0%-9.5%,TMTT全年销售额指引升至7.8亿-7.9亿美元(此前为7.6亿-7.8亿美元)。TMTT的高速放量反映出二尖瓣/三尖瓣经导管治疗正从早期导入期转向规模化放量阶段。
items.summary_en: Edwards Lifesciences' Q3 2026 results, reported Nov. 4, showed total sales of roughly $1.72 billion (+10.5% YoY) and adjusted EPS of $0.80 (+19% YoY). By franchise, TAVR sales were about $1.24 billion, up 8.8% in constant currency, while TMTT (transcatheter mitral and tricuspid therapies) sales reached $207 million, surging 45.6% in constant currency and far outpacing TAVR growth. The company raised its full-year 2026 guidance, lifting TAVR constant-currency growth to 9.0%-9.5% and TMTT sales guidance to $780-790 million (from $760-780 million previously), signaling that transcatheter mitral/tricuspid therapy is moving from early adoption into broader-scale uptake.
